context: Two teens debrief a school speech contest on the way home
purpose: Teach: 見れる/愚か/味わう/気に入ら/さよう/お断り/及ん/皆さま

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、さっきの優勝スピーチ、もう一度見れると思う?録画されてたよね。
lines.en: Hey, do you think we can watch that winning speech again? It was recorded, right?
lines.style: Sakura sounds excited, bouncy, slightly fangirling and eager to relive moments.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 見れると思うよ。でも正直、俺の出だしは愚かだったな…緊張で頭真っ白で。
lines.en: I think we can. But honestly, my opening was foolish — my mind went blank from nerves.
lines.style: Riku speaks low and self-critical, half-laughing at his own embarrassment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そんなことないって!後半めっちゃ良かったし、ああいうのは何回も味わう価値あるよ。
lines.en: No way! The second half was amazing — that kind of moment is worth savoring many times.
lines.style: Sakura's tone climbs with reassurance, warm and genuinely impressed by him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ありがと…でも審査員の一人、なんか俺の主張が気に入らなかったっぽくない?
lines.en: Thanks… but one of the judges seemed kind of displeased with my argument, didn't they?
lines.style: Riku's voice dips, suspicious and slightly bitter recalling a stern face.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あー、あの眼鏡の先生ね。質問もちょっと意地悪で、話が政治の方にまで及んでたし。
lines.en: Ah, the glasses guy. His questions were a bit mean too, and the talk even spilled into politics.
lines.style: Sakura's intonation rolls knowingly, gossipy and a little indignant on his behalf.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あの先生、「さようでございますか」みたいな喋り方でさ、マジで噛み合わなかった。
lines.en: That teacher talked all like 'is that so, indeed' — we seriously weren't on the same wavelength.
lines.style: Riku mimics a stiff formal voice mockingly, then snaps back to casual teen tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ、想像つく(笑)でも最後、追加質問お断りしたとこ、めっちゃ品があってカッコよかったよ。
lines.en: Ugh, I can totally picture it lol. But when you turned down the extra question at the end, it was so classy and cool.
lines.style: Sakura giggles affectionately, teasing yet sincere with a sparkle in her voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: やめろって、照れる…来年も出ようかな、今度こそ皆さまの前で頂点狙いたいし。
lines.en: Stop it, you're embarrassing me… maybe I'll enter again next year — this time I wanna aim for the top in front of everyone.
lines.style: Riku's voice softens, shy laugh sliding into quiet determination at the end.
